translation.title: Analgesic and Anti-inflammatory Cataplasm (Pap)
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of sprains, bruises, muscle pain, joint pain, pain from fractures, low back pain, stiff shoulders, neuralgia, and rheumatic pain.
translation.usage: Peel off the polyester film from the medicated surface and apply the patch to the affected area once or twice a day.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine in the following cases: eczema; dermatitis caused by lacquer or the like; wounded areas. Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this medicine in the following cases: people who are hypersensitive to medicines or cosmetics; people with an allergic constitution; people with severe moist skin or erosion; women who are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding. Follow the prescribed dosage and directions. When it is used by a child, use it under the supervision of a guardian. This medicine is for external use only. Do not use it for a long period. Do not warm the area where the patch is applied with a heater, an electric blanket or the like. If your symptoms do not improve after 5 to 6 days of use, stop using it and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if any of the following occur: rash and redness (congestion and reddening); itching; pain. Store at room temperature, protected from moisture and light. Keep out of reach of children.
